#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "local.h"

#define MAX(a, b) ((a) > (b) ? (a) : (b))
#define STR(x) #x

/* A linked list
 * node. */
typedef struct node {
    int value;
    struct node *next;
} node_t;

static const char *names[] = { "zero", "one", "two" };

unsigned long
hash(const char *str)
{
    unsigned long h = 5381;
    int c;
    while ((c = *str++))
        h = ((h << 5) + h) + c; /* h * 33 + c */
    return h;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    node_t *head = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < argc; i++) {
        node_t *n = malloc(sizeof *n);
        if (!n) {
            perror("malloc");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
        n->value = (int)hash(argv[i]) % 100;
        n->next = head;
        head = n;
    }
    printf("%s: %d\n", names[1], MAX(1, 2));
    char ch = '\n';
    float f = 1.5e-3f;
    long x = 0xFFL;
#ifdef DEBUG
    fprintf(stderr, "debug\n");
#endif
    return 0;
}
